create_ava_dataset: create an Ava dataset instance with a config object and train or test split
load_ava_data: load AVA frame paths and box annotations from config files into the dataset
preprocess_images_cv2: preprocess images and bounding boxes using OpenCV with random jitter, crop, and flip augmentations
preprocess_images_pytorch: preprocess images and bounding boxes using PyTorch transforms with scale jitter and random crop
get_ava_item: get a video clip with frames, labels, boxes, and metadata by index from the dataset
